title: HUGAGENT: BENCHMARKING LLMS FOR SIMULATION OF INDIVIDUALIZED HUMAN REASONING

bias_targets.target: Population prior reliance (Consensus bias / Identity flattening)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether models default to aggregate demographic distributions (No-Context) versus using individual reasoning histories (Full-Context), and using Cross-Person swap tests to measure the failure to preserve individualized reasoning over associative pattern matching.

Performing directional error decomposition on counterfactual belief updates to measure whether models fail to detect belief changes (preferring to keep stances static despite new contextual evidence) versus incorrectly inferring the direction of the change.

primary_bias_target: Population prior reliance (Consensus bias / Identity flattening)
